recompute.title: Preview of the changes
recompute.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved before you confirm.

settings.title: Edit the settings
settings.deleted: This challenge is deleted: restore it before changing its settings.

warning.upcoming: This challenge is upcoming, and these settings are frozen for its participants. Changing them recomputes its rankings.
warning.ongoing: This challenge is ongoing, and these settings are frozen for its participants. Changing them recomputes its rankings.
warning.finished: This challenge is finished, and these settings are frozen for its participants. Changing them recomputes its rankings and its results.

settings.previewNote: The preview shows the weeks judged again and the rankings before and after, before anything is saved.
settings.serverInvalid: Value refused. Check it, then see the preview again.
settings.bounds: The bounds stay the same: {{minWeeks}} to {{maxWeeks}} weeks, factors from {{minFactor}} to {{maxFactor}}.
settings.invalid: A field is refused: fix it, then see the preview again.

participants.title: Participants
participants.empty: No one takes part in this challenge.

help.exclude: Once excluded, they are eliminated from every category and shown as having left. You can reinstate them.
help.excludeCreator: Once excluded, they are eliminated from every category and shown as having left, but keep the creator role: remove it separately. You can reinstate them.
help.reinstate: Once reinstated, they are active again: the weeks already locked are judged again with them.

search.label: Search the account to add by username, name or email
search.hint: Search the account by its username, name or email.

makeCreator.title: Make {{name}} a creator
makeCreator.made: {{name}} is now a creator of the challenge.

removeCreator.title: Remove the creator role from {{name}}
removeCreator.made: {{name}} is no longer a creator of the challenge.

errors.already_participant: This account already takes part in this challenge.
errors.participation_abandoned: This account left this challenge or was excluded from it: reinstate it from the participant list.
errors.profile_incomplete: This account has not given its first and last names yet: it cannot join any challenge.
errors.not_active_participant: This account does not take part in this challenge.
errors.last_creator: This is the last creator of the challenge: make someone else a creator first.
errors.not_found: This account no longer takes part in this challenge.
errors.challenge_not_found: This challenge no longer exists or was deleted.

activityForm.deleted: This account is deleted: its activities are erased.
activityForm.note: Admin mode. Judged weeks and finished challenges do not block the entry. The entry rules stay the same: duration, distance required depending on the sport, no overlap with another activity of {{name}}.

edit.title: Edit an activity of {{name}}
edit.reasonTitle: Confirm the change to the activity

errors.activity_overlap: This activity overlaps another activity of this account. Check the start and the duration.
errors.profile_incomplete: This account has not entered its first and last name yet: no activity can be added to it.
errors.activity_not_found: This activity no longer exists: it may have been deleted in the meantime.

delete.title: Delete the challenge
delete.help: It disappears for everyone. Nothing is erased: you can restore it.
delete.summary: “{{title}}” will disappear for everyone and its invitation links will stop working. Nothing is erased: you can restore it.

restore.notice: It no longer shows for anyone, but nothing is erased: it can be restored at any time.

points.found: The challenge shows again for its participants, with their activities: they were never erased.
points.weeks: The weeks that ended while it was deleted are judged by the recalculation.
points.links: Its invitation links that are neither revoked nor expired work again. Accounts deleted in the meantime do not come back.
points.preview: The preview shows the resulting rankings before you confirm, then the reason is asked.

restore.title: Restore “{{title}}”
restore.made: “{{title}}” is restored and its rankings are recalculated.

update.pseudoHint: 3 to 20 characters: letters, digits, _, . or -. Left empty, the nickname is removed.
update.summary: The profile of {{name}} changes as follows:

block.title: Block the account
block.help: {{name}} will no longer be able to use the app. Their rankings stay: to take this account out of a challenge, exclude it from that challenge.
block.summary: {{name}} will not be able to use the app while the account stays blocked. Their challenges do not change.

errors.forbidden: You cannot block your own account.

unblock.title: Unblock the account
unblock.help: The account is blocked: {{name}} can no longer use the app.
unblock.summary: {{name}} will be able to use the app again.

delete.title: Delete the account
delete.help: Same effect as if its owner deleted it: their ongoing challenges are abandoned, their activities erased, and the account deleted at Auth0.
delete.summary: The account of {{name}} will be deleted: their ongoing challenges are abandoned and their activities erased. This cannot be undone.

errors.forbidden: You cannot make this change to this account.
errors.last_creator: This account is the last creator of an ongoing challenge: first name another creator, or delete the challenge.
